Questions, answered

Are the macros exact?

Not yet. They're estimates from standard nutrition data until our panels are checked by a nutrition professional. We'll mark verified meals.

When can I change my box?

Any time before Sunday night for the next week's route. After that, your box is being cooked.

Can I skip or pause?

Yes. Skip any delivery or pause for 1 to 8 weeks from My Plan. Skipped weeks are never charged.

How do I store and heat the meals?

Keep them frozen and follow the date and heating steps on each bag.

Do you deliver to me?

We run weekly routes Tuesday to Friday across the GTA and some of Ontario for $20 to $35, with a $100 minimum. Pickup at Brimley Rd is free.

Is the GLP-1 Companion medical advice?

No. It's smaller, protein-first meals. Follow your prescriber's advice.

Can I cancel?

Yes, from My Plan, before the Sunday cut-off, with no fee.
